## Summary

Dargis is the fisherman husband of [Rimgailė](rimgaile_palanga.qmd). When the keeper collapses on the sand by the burning kneeling statue in December 1449, Rimgailė calls and Dargis comes running bare-headed, staring at the fire and at the stranger; by the end of a month he is lifting the sick man from the bench by the hand.

## Record vs saga

- **[Saga invention]:** Dargis and his household are invented; Palanga's fishing families are the setting, not a record.

## Appearances

**Book V:** ch. 25 (a Dargis already named among the Palanga fishers), ch. 29.
